proposal.summary: Batch D1 holds five unrelated CM550 features, all run from executive task sets (5 ms frames in a 40-frame cycle) whose other callees lie partly above the dumped ROM, so the three listed wrappers (and the lamp task's wrapper 0x1b70c) keep the schedule slot names HEAD already uses. The duty cycle monitor (0xac3c, with its start-up 0xaf70 and power-down 0xb130) turns the fueling into a load ratio every 100 ms and counts the engine speed / load region in a long term map and an active short term map, and the boost pressure in-range high check (0xe998) sets fault code 433 when boost stays high at low load near idle. The idle shutdown state machine (0x1d9b4, state word ISST: RESET / COUNT / WARNING / DELAY / OVERRIDE / SHUTDOWN; initializer 0x1db8a) counts the idle timer down, requests the warning lamp flash and commands the engine shutdown; CM848 S90140.06 has no idle shutdown machine, so it stays CM550 only. The lamp control task (0x254b6, every 50 ms) runs the power-up lamp sequence, then by priority the fault code flash out, the shutdown warning flashes and the active fault lamps, plus three oil change monitor flash patterns (0x253b0 acknowledges a monitor reset); none of the old callee names fits its code. The serial EEPROM driver start-up (0x26854) sets up the QSPI, loads the EEPROM into the RAM mirror by polling and then refreshes the mirror through the QSPI interrupt handler 0x26834, 0x26852 is an empty stub, and 0x26e2c computes the percent load on the low horsepower torque curve (the counterpart of CM848 0x50e000, which adds a clamp).

functions.role: Takes one duty cycle monitor sample: computes the load factor from the fueling, picks the engine speed / load region and adds 1 to that region's counter in the long term map and in the active short term map.
functions.discriminator: The only duty cycle monitor function that tests the enable bit (andi.w #0x8 on algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal at 0xac58), computes the region byte DCMNOPRN and increments map counters; its siblings 0xaf70 (start-up: converts the stored maps into the processing maps) and 0xb130 (power-down: converts them back) only convert.
functions.plate_comment: Duty cycle monitor sample (e2m DCMN records; enable = bit 3 of algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal), once per 100 ms from cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase3 while engine_state is not STOPPED. The 100 percent throttle fueling at the engine speed (limited to the cutoffs DCMNLOES / DCMNHIES) is FSMXTHFL between the cutoffs, else the steady state and transient 4D fueling tables at 100 percent throttle blended by ALPHA; load ratio = (FSFNFL - NLFL) x 10000 / (that fueling - NLFL), copied to DCMNLDFA (0 when negative). Region DCMNOPRN = speed bin (first 8 values of DCMNESTB) + (6 - load bin of DCMNLDTB) x 8, or 49 / 50 for a negative ratio below / at or above the high cutoff; that region's counter and the total get +1 in the long term map (DCMNLGMP, DCLGMPTL, up to 3600000000) and in the short term processing map DCMNSHNU selects (1 or 2; a map fills until its total reaches DCMNSHTI hours x 36000). The counterpart of cm848_updateDutyCycleMonitorLoadHistogram (CM848 has no short term maps).
functions.evidence: 0xac52-0xac68 enable bit 0x8 of 0x803cb8 and engine_state (0x80d0c8) != 1; 0xac6c-0xacba map start times (0x805390 / 0x805388 / 0x80538c = engine hour meter 0x80ccee); 0xacbc-0xadb8 speed against 0x807d18 / 0x807d1a, x inputs 0x800016 / 0x80002c, ALPHA 0x80a8f8 = 0x4000 / 0 / blend (mulu, lsr 14) of two cm550_tableLookup2D calls (0x800010 = e2m 1055 / 1054 / 1056 steady state 4D fueling, 0x800026 = 1058 / 1057 / 1059 transient; y input 0x190 set by 0xaf70), else move.w 0x80d368 at 0xadb8; 0xadc2-0xae18 ratio: x 10000 (shift-add) then divs.l, or the word 0x807d40 when the fueling equals NLFL 0x80db1c; 0xae1e-0xae46 negative: 0x80bad4 = 0 and region 0x31 / 0x32; 0xae4a-0xaec8 two axis searches (0x807d20 8 entries, 0x807d34 6 entries), region = (6 - load) x 8 + speed at 0xaec0-0xaec8; 0xaeca cmpi.l #0xd693a400 then addq.l on 0x80546e + 4 x region and 0x805398; 0xaeea-0xaf32 active map byte 0x80bad7 from the totals 0x80bacc / 0x80bad0 against the limit 0x800006; 0xaf34-0xaf68 addq.l on 0x80bada / 0x80bba8 + 4 x region and the total. Single caller: jsr at 0x1b78e. CM848 0x50638c: same enable bit, same STOPPED gate, same x 10000 ratio, 8 speed breakpoints, long term cap 3600000000; differs: 10 load breakpoints (regions to 82), 13000 clamp, no short term maps, percent time at load words.

functions.role: The boost pressure in-range high diagnostic: at low load near idle speed, boost pressure that stays above a threshold sets the fault bit of Cummins fault code 433.
functions.discriminator: The only reader of boost_pressure_in_range_diagnostic_enable in the dumped ROM; it owns the two counters 0x800178 / 0x80017a and holds the only ori.w #0x2000 / andi.w #0xdfff on system error status word 1 (0x806002; fault index 91 = fault code 433). The out-of-range boost faults 122 / 123 (bits 0x200 / 0x400) are only read here, as inhibits.
functions.plate_comment: Boost pressure in-range high check (e2m 123D DGBSDCTR / DGBSHTTD / DGLWTD / DGLSRSOF / DGSTBSTD; enable = bit 4 of algorithm_enable_flags_27_cal, DGBSIREN), once per 100 ms from cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase1. It runs while engine_state is RUNNING, neither boost circuit fault (status word 1 bits 0x200 / 0x400 with their confirm bits) is active, engine speed ESCMES is at most LSRF + DGLSRSOF and percent load JCPCLD is at most DGLWTD; otherwise the dwell count is zeroed and the debounce count set to 1. After DGBSDCTR passes of dwell the debounce count goes up while boost pressure BSTPRS is above DGSTBSTD and down otherwise; above DGBSHTTD it sets bit 0x2000 of system error status word 1 and of the first occurrence word (fault code 433), and at 0 it clears the status bit once the first occurrence bit is clear. The counterpart of the last block of cm848_monitorBoostPressureSensorAndUnderboost.
functions.evidence: 0xe9b4-0xe9be andi.w #0x10 on 0x803cca; 0xe9c2 cmpi.w #3 on engine_state; 0xe9ce-0xea12 the two inhibits (0x806002 and 0x806abe masks 0x400 then 0x200); 0xea16-0xea32 0x80db02 + 0x807c0a against 0x80ccf4; 0xea36-0xea42 0x80db5e against 0x807c08; 0xea46-0xea4c dwell (a3 = 0x800178) up to (a5) = 0x807c04; 0xea54-0xea70 0x80a320 against 0x807c0c, debounce (a2 = 0x80017a) +1 while <= (a4) = 0x807c06 else -1; 0xea72-0xea90 ori.w #0x2000 on 0x806002 and 0x806042 with interrupts masked; 0xea98-0xeac8 clear; 0xead0 clr.w (a3), move.w #1,(a2). Fault mapping from the RAM dump: DGFUCATB 0x80656c word 29 (16 x 1 + 13) = 91, fault data record 0x8067c4 + 6 x 91 = 433; words 25 / 26 = fault indexes 3 / 4 = codes 122 / 123. Dump: DGBSDCTR 200, DGBSHTTD 25, DGLWTD 1792, DGLSRSOF 400, DGSTBSTD 314. Single caller: jsr at 0x1b754. CM848 0x52daf0-0x52dca4 inside 0x52d6a8: the same five records (e2m 1631 +0..+8 at ROM 0x642b4-0x642bc) in the same order of tests (speed 0x52daf0, load 0x52db14, dwell 0x52db34, boost 0x52db94, debounce 0x52dba4, set 0x52dbd8, clear 0x52dc20), but inside a larger monitor with CM848's fault bookkeeping.

Two of its three callees (0x4115a, 0x41256) are above the dumped ROM, so no role name can be proven; the slot is what the code shows. CM848's slot mate (cm848_periodicTaskGroup26_calibration8) shares no task with it, so standalone.
functions.plate_comment: Executive frame task set: runs every 20 frames (100 ms), in frames 1 and 21 of the 40-frame cycle, as call 6 of those frames in executiveFrameInterruptHandler. Calls, in order: cm550_monitorBoostPressureSensorInRangeHighReading, 0x4115a (not dumped), 0x41256 (not dumped). CM848's slot mate is cm848_periodicTaskGroup26_calibration8, with a different task list.
functions.evidence: 0x1b754 jsr 0xe998 / 0x1b75a jsr 0x4115a / 0x1b760 jsr 0x41256 / 0x1b766 rts. Callers: bsr.w at 0x1b99e (frame 1 code at 0x1b98c = jump table 0x1b90e + 0x7e) and 0x1bc5c (frame 21 at 0x1bc4a = + 0x33c); each frame calls jsr (a5) = 0x1b4d0, the 2-frame, 4-frame, 8-frame, 10-frame sets and this 20-frame set. A frame is 5 ms: ISTM (0.1 s per count) drops 1 per pass of a 20-frame task, LCLPONTM (50 ms per count) counts 10-frame passes. HEAD (commit 7cf52470, after the frozen copy) already carries this name. CM848 executive (twin, 0xc0a0): cases 1 and 0x15 call cm848_periodicTaskGroup26_calibration8 in the same position.

functions.role: Steps the idle shutdown state machine (state word ISST, six states): counts the idle shutdown timer down, requests the warning lamp flash, handles the override and, at the end of the warning, commands the engine shutdown.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the state word ISST (0x80d674) apart from the initializer, and the only code that sets the engine shutdown command SHSS from the idle shutdown timer. The other two readers of idle_shutdown_enable only report: the J1587 PID 71 status byte (0xefa2) and the PGN 65252 payload builder (0x33d38).
functions.plate_comment: Idle shutdown state machine (e2m 10CD; state ISST 0 RESET / 1 COUNT / 2 WARNING / 3 DELAY / 4 OVERRIDE / 5 SHUTDOWN), one pass per 100 ms from cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase11 while ISAGEN (bit 1 of algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal) is set and ISTAEN (bit 4 of word 28) is clear. RESET reloads the timer ISTM from ISTMLM and waits for ISRSFG = 0; COUNT counts ISTM down, returns to RESET on ISRSFG = 1 and enters WARNING when ISTM is at or below ISWRTMLM (or DELAY, 600 passes before OVERRIDE, when ISAATPEN and ISODFG are set); WARNING sets ISWRRQ and after ISWRTMLM passes enters SHUTDOWN, unless ISODEN with ISODFG gives OVERRIDE or ISRSWNFG gives RESET; OVERRIDE reloads the timer, sets ISOD and ISODRQ and waits for ISODRSFG; SHUTDOWN sets the engine shutdown command SHSS once and returns to RESET when the engine is CRANKING. The condition flags ISRSFG / ISRSWNFG / ISODRSFG / ISODFG have no writer in the dumped ROM; CM848 S90140.06 has no idle shutdown machine.
functions.evidence: 0x1d9ca-0x1d9d6 andi.l #0x2 on 0x803c9a (beq exit); 0x1d9da-0x1d9e6 andi.l #0x10 on 0x803ccc (bne exit); 0x1d9ea-0x1d9fc state (a3 = 0x80d674) through the jump table 0x1da00 = 000c 0048 00a0 00f8 0122 0148. Case 2 0x1daa0: subq, move.w #1,(a1), addq.w #1 on 0x800754, andi.l #0x4 on 0x803c9a with 0x80d682 = 1 -> 4, 0x80d67e = 1 -> 0, 0x800754 >= 0x808150 -> 5. Case 3 0x1daf8: subq.w #1 on 0x800756, 0x80d67c = 1 -> 0, timer 0 -> 4. Case 4 0x1db22: timer reload, clr.w (a1), move.w #1 to 0x80d684 and 0x80d672, 0x80d680 = 1 -> 0. Case 5 0x1db48: when the previous state 0x800752 is not 5: clr.w (a1), move.w #1 to 0x80d28c, output 30 on (ori.b #0x40); engine_state = 2 -> 0. 0x1db7e stores the entry state in 0x800752. e2m addresses from the parameter ID table (10CD +0..+12, 0008 +66, 10CC +8). functions.role: Flashes the warning lamp three times (5 or 6 ticks on, 18 off; 50 ms per tick) to acknowledge a manual reset of the oil change monitor.
functions.discriminator: Of the three fixed-pattern flash generators the lamp task calls, this is the one on lamp request bit 0x2 (the warning lamp), with its own tick counter 0x801a1a and busy flag 0x801a1c, and the one the caller gates with OCRSFG (0x80dab0); 0x25316 and 0x25448 flash bit 0x4 for OCITWNFG.
functions.plate_comment: Oil change monitor reset acknowledgement: called every 50 ms by cm550_runLampControl while OCRSFG (e2m 1094 +12, 'a manual reset was performed on OCM data') is set or a flash cycle is still running. It counts ticks in 0x801a1a and requests the warning lamp (bit 0x2 of lamp_driver_output_bitmask) during ticks 1-5, 24-29 and 48-53, clears the request in between, and at tick 72 clears the busy flag 0x801a1c and restarts the count. CM848 has no counterpart.

CM848: oil_change_monitor_reset_flag 0x40ae60 is used only by cm848_j1939HandlePgn56832Reset and cm848_updateOilChangeMonitor.

functions.role: The lamp control task (every 50 ms): runs the power-up lamp sequence, then by priority the fault code flash out, the shutdown warning flashes and the active fault lamps, plus the three oil change monitor flash patterns, and saves the idle increment / idle decrement / diagnostic switch states for edge detection.
functions.discriminator: The single entry of the lamp family from the executive (its only caller is the 10-frame task set 0x1b70c) and the only function that calls the seven lamp functions and decides their priority; it owns the power-up tick count 0x801a22 and the switch previous-state bytes 0x8019eb-0x8019ed.
functions.plate_comment: Lamp control task (Calterm group LAMP_CON), every 50 ms from cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase5. While the power-up lamp sequence is active it only runs cm550_runPowerUpLampSequence; afterwards cm550_runFaultCodeFlashOut has the stop and warning lamps first, then cm550_flashShutdownWarningLamps, and only when both are idle cm550_updateActiveFaultLamps. Independently it runs cm550_flashEngineProtectionLampForOilChangeDueAtPowerUp (passes 100 to 399 after power-up while OCITWNFG is set), cm550_flashWarningLampForOilChangeMonitorReset (OCRSFG) and cm550_flashEngineProtectionLampForOilChangeDueWhileRunning (OCRNSTEA and OCITWNFG while RUNNING). Last it stores the idle increment / idle decrement / diagnostic switch states (bits 0x20 / 0x40 / 0x80 of the switch byte 0x80bccf) for the next pass's edge detection.

functions.role: The QSPI interrupt handler of the serial EEPROM driver: clears the QSPI finished flag, runs one driver step and restarts the QSPI queue.
functions.discriminator: It is the interrupt entry (saves d0-d1 / a0-a1 and ends in RTE) and has no caller: 0x26854 stores its address in the RAM vector 0x808f20 (vector 0x51, the QSPI vector for QIVR 0x50). The driver step itself is 0x266da, which the start-up load loop of 0x26854 calls directly.
functions.plate_comment: QSPI interrupt handler of the serial EEPROM driver (reached through RAM vector 81 at 0x808f20 = VBR 0x808ddc + 4 x 0x51, installed by mc68k_initializeSerialEepromDriverAndLoadMirror; not called). It clears SPIF (QSM_SPSR bit 7), runs mc68k_runSerialEepromWriteQueue (stores the 12 words just read into the EEPROM mirror and queues the next read, or sends / polls a queued byte write) and sets SPE (QSM_SPCR1 bit 15) to start the next queue pass. The counterpart of cm848_onQspiFinished.
functions.evidence: 0x26834 movem.l d0-d1/a0-a1; 0x26838 andi.b #0x7f on 0xfffc1f; 0x26840 bsr.w 0x266da; 0x26844 ori.w #0x8000 on 0xfffc1a; 0x26850 4e73 rte. Only reference: the immediate of move.l #0x26834,(0x808f20).l at 0x26860. VBR: movea.l #0x808ddc,a0 and movec a0,VBR (4e7b 8801) at 0x2864a-0x28650; QILR = 0x13 at 0x28664, QIVR = 0x50 at 0x2866c. CM848 0x3dcf4: clears SPSR SPIF then runs the QSPI job completion - the same two steps for every QSPI job, not only the EEPROM.

functions.role: Start-up of the serial EEPROM driver: installs the QSPI interrupt handler, sets up the QSPI and its read queue, loads the whole EEPROM (0x148a bytes) into the RAM mirror at 0x803b0a by polling, then switches to interrupt mode with the refresh length 0x64c.
functions.discriminator: The only function that writes the QSM / QSPI configuration for the EEPROM (PQSPAR, DDRQS, SPCR0-2, the command RAM) and the driver's length word 0x801a88, and the only place the driver step runs by polling (with both watchdogs serviced in the loop).
functions.plate_comment: Start-up of the serial EEPROM driver, called once by mc68k_applicationMain after the QSM interrupt set-up. It stores mc68k_serialEepromQspiInterruptHandler in RAM vector 0x808f20, configures the QSPI (master, 16 bits, queue entries 2 to 15: READ, the address, 12 data words), sets ram_refresh_enable (e2m 10C7 RREN) and the mirror base 0x803b0a, and with the length 0x148a runs the queue by polling (mc68k_runSerialEepromWriteQueue after each pass, both watchdogs serviced) until the mirror is loaded. Then it enables the QSPI interrupt and sets the length to 0x64c, so the driver keeps refreshing RAM 0x803b0a-0x804155 (the _cal range) from the EEPROM. The counterpart of cm848_initEepromDriverAndLoadMirror.

functions.role: Runs the power-up lamp sequence: first pass switches every output of the sequence table on, then switches them off one by one on a tick schedule and at the end releases them.

functions.plate_comment: Power-up lamp sequence (e2m 1006 +8 LCLPTB, 16 output numbers), every 50 ms from cm550_runLampControl while the sequence flag 0x8019d2 is set (cm550_startPowerUpLampSequence sets it). First pass: every table output whose override priority is at most 0x80 gets priority 0x80 and is switched on; the first switch-off is due at tick 40. At each due tick the current table output goes off and the next one is due 10 ticks later; after the last entry (a 0 entry or the table end) one more step follows 30 ticks later, then every table output's priority is released, the flag is cleared and the three switch previous-state bytes are zeroed.

functions.role: Flashes the warning lamp while the idle shutdown warning is requested, the stop lamp while an engine protection shutdown is approaching, and the warning lamp 120 times after an idle shutdown override; returns 1 when none of the three is active.

It returns 0 while any of the three is active, which keeps cm550_updateActiveFaultLamps from running.

functions.role: Runs the fault code flash out: with the diagnostic switch on and the engine stopped it picks the active fault to show (switch edges or automatic mode) and flashes its code on the warning and stop lamps; returns 1 when the mode is off.
functions.discriminator: The only reader of the diagnostic test switch bit (0x80 of the switch byte 0x80bccf) together with the idle increment / decrement edges, and the only caller of the next / previous fault selectors and of the digit flasher. The old name fits loosely (it does control which fault code is shown), but the code flashes lamps - there is no display - and Calterm calls the feature fault flash.
functions.plate_comment: Fault code flash out (e2m 13EF LCFUFHMD automatic fault flash mode / LCFUFHCU fault flash count), every 50 ms from cm550_runLampControl. A rising edge of the diagnostic switch starts with the first active fault, the idle increment / decrement switches step to the next / previous one, and in automatic mode each code is repeated LCFUFHCU times before the next. With no fault to show (index 125) it requests both lamps on, else it calls cm550_flashFaultCodeDigits with the fault's Cummins code (fault data record 0x8067c4 + 6 x index).

A new fault clears the lamp bits, the phase 0x8019d6, the cycle counter 0x8019d8 and the digit count 0x8019ee. 0x24ede cmpi.b #0x7d,(a3): ori.w #1 and #2, else jsr 0x24b4e with the word at 0x8067c4 + 6 x index; 0x24f0a clr.b d0. functions.role: Converts the duty cycle monitor's short term processing maps and totals (0.1 s ticks) back into the stored maps (minutes, rounded), at power-down.

Each processing total (DCPR01TL / DCPR02TL) becomes the stored total DCMP01TL / DCMP02TL in minutes ((ticks x 60 + 18000) / 36000, or the period in minutes when the map is full), and the 50 region counters of each processing map (DCSHPR01 / DCSHPR02) become the words of the stored maps DCMNMP01 / DCMNMP02 the same way.

functions.role: Calculates the two percent load words: FSPCLD = fueling above no load over the 100 percent throttle fueling, and JCPCLD = the same fueling over what is available at the current engine speed (the high speed governor droop line above its derate speed), each in 1/256 percent.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of FSPCLD (0x80db60) and JCPCLD (0x80db5e); its sibling 0x26e2c, called right after it, writes the third percent load word from the low horsepower curve fueling. Nothing in it is a speed ratio, and CM848 has no function of this name.
functions.plate_comment: Percent load calculation (e2m 10BF +2 FSPCLD and +0 JCPCLD, 1/256 percent), once per 100 ms from cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase3. FSPCLD = (FSFNFL - NLFL) x 25600 / (FSMXTHFL - NLFL), clamped at 0x7f80, 0 when either fueling is not above NLFL. JCPCLD uses as its denominator the fueling available at the current speed: above the high speed governor derate speed with droop active the droop line (clamped at 0x1700) minus NLFL, else FSMXTHFL - NLFL; it is clamped at 0x7f80 and forced to 0x6400 (100 percent) while final_fueling_state is HIGH_SPEED_GOVERNOR. The counterpart of cm848_calculateEngineLoadPercentages.
functions.evidence: 0x26ce8-0x26cf2 guards (a5 = 0x80d32e) and (a4 = 0x80d368) above (a2 = 0x80db1c); 0x26cf4-0x26d10 cm550_scaleByRatio(FSFNFL - NLFL, 0x6400, FSMXTHFL - NLFL); 0x26d18-0x26d32 clamp 0x7f80 and move.w to 0x80db60, else clr.w; 0x26d4a-0x26d5e speed 0x80ccf6 above 0x80d654 with the droop flag 0x80d656; 0x26d72-0x26dd2 the droop line: x 0x1111, slope 0x80d652, full fueling 0x80d36c, clamp 0x1700; 0x26de0-0x26e12 x 25600 against denominator x 0x7f80, divu.l, move.w to (a3 = 0x80db5e); 0x26e14 cmpi.w #0xc on final_fueling_state 0x80d330 -> move.w #0x6400. functions.role: One step of the serial EEPROM driver after a QSPI queue pass: in the read state it stores the 12 words just read into the RAM mirror and sets the next read address; with a write queued it sends write enable + one byte write and then polls the status register until the write is done.
functions.discriminator: The only code that touches the QSPI transmit / receive RAM for the EEPROM after start-up and the only user of the state dword 0x801a8a. The name stays: it is incomplete rather than wrong - it covers states 1 and 2, while state 0, the normal one, is the read stream that loads and refreshes the EEPROM mirror; the plate comment now says so.
functions.plate_comment: Serial EEPROM driver step, run after each QSPI queue pass (by mc68k_serialEepromQspiInterruptHandler, and by polling during the start-up load). In state 0 of eeprom_byte_write_state (no write in progress) it copies the 12 received words to the mirror at eeprom_mirror_base_pointer + eeprom_mirror_load_offset (the store is skipped while ram_refresh_enable is 0), advances the offset, wraps it at eeprom_mirror_load_length (setting eeprom_mirror_loaded_flag) and queues the next READ; when the write queue is not empty it goes to state 1. State 1 sends command 6 (write enable) and command 2 (write) with the next queue entry (address word 0x80BDA8 + 2 x read index, data byte 0x80C7A8 + index). State 2 sends command 5 (read status) until the write-in-progress bit is clear, then continues with the next write or returns to reading at the saved offset.

enum_members.comment: Not counting: the timer is held at the idle shutdown period, the lamp requests and the overridden / override successful flags are cleared and output 30 is off; leaves to COUNT when idle_shutdown_reset_flag is 0. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x00. (new enum, size 2, type of idle_shutdown_state)
enum_members.evidence: Case 0 at 0x1da0c-0x1da44. e2m ISRSFG names the pair: '1 - transition to reset from count; 0 - transition to count' = the 1 -> 0 and 0 -> 1 transitions on 0x80d67c. PGN 65252 builder 0x33d66 clr.b. SPN positions for all six members: the SAE J1939-71 layout of PGN 65252 byte 1 (bits 1-2 SPN 593, 3-4 SPN 594, 5-6 SPN 592, 7-8 SPN 590); the local database lists the parameters in that order but stores no bit positions, and the builder's other bytes follow the same order (byte 2 bits 7-8 by the enable bit = SPN 591, byte 3 bits 1-2 the A/C switch = SPN 985, byte 4 bits 1-2 the wait to start lamp output = SPN 1081). Label corroboration: the CHR_B2 e2m record Idle_Shutdown_State '0=RESET:1=COUNT:2=WARNING:3=DELAY:4=OVERRIDE:5=SHUTDOWN'.

enum_members.comment: The idle shutdown timer counts down (0.1 s per pass): to RESET on the reset flag, to DELAY when the temperature option and the override successful flag are set, to WARNING when the timer is at or below the warning period. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x40 (SPN 590 idle shutdown timer state active).
enum_members.evidence: Case 1 at 0x1da48-0x1da9c (subq.w #1 on the timer; move.w #0 / #3 / #2 to the state). PGN 65252 builder 0x33d6a move.b #0x40.

enum_members.comment: Shutdown approaching: sets the warning lamp request ISWRRQ and counts passes; to OVERRIDE when the override is enabled and successful, to RESET on the reset from warning flag, to SHUTDOWN after the warning period. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x44 (timer state active + SPN 594 driver alert mode active).
enum_members.evidence: Case 2 at 0x1daa0-0x1daf4 (move.w #1 to 0x80d67a; move.w #4 / #0 / #5). e2m ISRSWNFG 'transition to reset from warning' is the 2 -> 0 test at 0x1dad0. PGN 65252 builder 0x33d70 move.b #0x44.

enum_members.comment: A 600-pass (60 s) delay before the override, entered from COUNT with the temperature option: to RESET on the reset flag, to OVERRIDE when the delay timer reaches 0. PGN 65252 byte 1 is left unchanged. No J90350.00 e2m text names this state; the name is the code's delay timer, and the later CHR_B2 e2m labels value 3 DELAY.
enum_members.evidence: Case 3 at 0x1daf8-0x1db20 (subq.w #1 on 0x800756, preset 0x258 at 0x1da54; move.w #0 / #4). PGN 65252 builder: table entry 3 = 0x26 -> 0x33d80, no store.

enum_members.comment: Idle shutdown overridden: the timer is reloaded, the warning request cleared, ISOD (overridden until the vehicle moves) and the override lamp request ISODRQ set; to RESET on the reset from override flag. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x10 (SPN 592 idle shutdown timer override active).
enum_members.evidence: Case 4 at 0x1db22-0x1db46 (move.w #1 to 0x80d684 and 0x80d672). e2m ISODRSFG 'transition to reset from override' is the 4 -> 0 test at 0x1db3a. PGN 65252 builder 0x33d76 move.b #0x10.

enum_members.comment: The idle shutdown has shut the engine down: on entry the warning request is cleared, the engine shutdown command SHSS set and output 30 switched on; to RESET when engine_state is CRANKING. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x01 (SPN 593 idle shutdown has shut down engine).
enum_members.evidence: Case 5 at 0x1db48-0x1db7c (move.w #1 to 0x80d28c under cmpi.w #5 on the previous state; cmpi.w #2 on engine_state). PGN 65252 builder 0x33d7c move.b #0x1.

enum_members.comment: No write in progress: the driver step stores the words read into the EEPROM mirror and queues the next read; a queued write takes it to SEND_WRITE. (new enum, size 4, type of eeprom_byte_write_state)
enum_members.evidence: tst.l (a1 = 0x801a8a) at 0x26756 with the read path 0x2675a-0x267ae; clr.l at 0x2673e and 0x2693a.

enum_members.comment: Send the next queued byte write: write enable (command 6) and write (command 2) with the queue entry's address and data byte; then WAIT_FOR_COMPLETION.
enum_members.evidence: cmp.l #1 at 0x267b6-0x267ba with the write path 0x267bc-0x2682c; move.l #1 at 0x2673a and 0x267a4.

enum_members.comment: A write was sent: read the status register (command 5) each pass until the write-in-progress bit is clear, then SEND_WRITE when more is queued, else IDLE with a READ at the saved offset.
enum_members.evidence: cmp.l #2 at 0x266ea with the status path 0x266f0-0x26754; move.l #2 at 0x2680a.

Above the debounce limit it sets system error bit 29 and its first-occurrence bit, at debounce 0 it clears the status bit once the first-occurrence bit is clear, and a failed condition resets the dwell to 0 and the debounce to 1.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_RESET - the timer is reloaded with the period, the warning request, the overridden flag ISOD and ISODFG are cleared and output 30 is cleared; it leaves to COUNT when the reset flag ISRSFG is 0.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 0 at 0x1da0c-0x1da44 (jump table 0x1da00). The e2m text of the flag it tests, ISRSFG at 0x80d67c, names both states: '1 - transition to reset from count; 0 - transition to count' - and the code goes 0 -> 1 on ISRSFG = 0 and 1 -> 0 on ISRSFG = 1. The initializer stores 0, and the PGN 65252 callback sends byte 1 = 0x00 for it (nothing active). Corroboration: the Idle_Shutdown_State record of the later CHR_B2 e2m files, whose description is ISST's sentence, labels the values 0=RESET:1=COUNT:2=WARNING:3=DELAY:4=OVERRIDE:5=SHUTDOWN.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_COUNT - the timer counts down; back to RESET on ISRSFG = 1, to DELAY when the temperature option is enabled and ISODFG is 1, to WARNING when the timer is at or below the warning period. It also zeroes the warning timer and loads the delay timer with 600.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 1 at 0x1da48-0x1da9c: subq.w #1 on the timer ISTM ('dec. and hold timer'). ISRSFG text as for state 0. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x40 (SPN 590 idle shutdown timer state = active).

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_WARNING - the timer keeps counting down, the lamp request ISWRRQ is 1 and a warning timer (0x800754) counts up; to OVERRIDE when the override option is enabled and ISODFG is 1, to RESET on ISRSWNFG = 1, to SHUTDOWN when the warning timer reaches the warning period.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 2 at 0x1daa0-0x1daf4. The texts of the words it uses name the state: ISWRRQ 'blink yellow lamp to indicate idle shutdown approach', ISRSWNFG '1 - transition to reset from warning', ISWRTMLM 'time allotted to indicate approaching shutdown'. PGN 65252 byte 1 = 0x44 (timer active + SPN 594 driver alert mode).

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_DELAY - a 600-pass (60 s) countdown of the delay timer 0x800756 before the override; to RESET on ISRSFG = 1, to OVERRIDE when the countdown reaches 0.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 3 at 0x1daf8-0x1db20: it only counts 0x800756 down and tests ISRSFG; entered only from COUNT with idle_shutdown_temperature_enable set and ISODFG = 1, and COUNT loads the 600 each pass. The word DELAY is the later family's label (0=RESET:1=COUNT:2=WARNING:3=DELAY:4=OVERRIDE:5=SHUTDOWN in the CHR_B2 Idle_Shutdown_State record). This is the weakest member.

enum_roles.meaning: IDLE_SHUTDOWN_STATE_OVERRIDE - the timer is held at the period, the warning request is cleared, the overridden flag ISOD and the override lamp request ISODRQ are set; to RESET on ISODRSFG = 1.
enum_roles.evidence: Case 4 at 0x1db22-0x1db46. The texts of its words name the state: ISOD '1 - idle shutdown is overridden until vehicle moves', ISODRQ 'blink yellow lamp to indicate idle shutdown is overridden', ISODRSFG '1 - transition to reset from override'. It runs while engine_state is RUNNING, neither boost pressure circuit fault is active (bit 0x400 / 0x200 of system error status word 1 = Cummins codes 123 / 122, each counted only while the same bit of word 1 of the fault processing enable bitmap DGFUIDEN, 0x806abe, is set), engine speed ESCMES is at most LSRF + DGLSRSOF and percent load JCPCLD is at most DGLWTD; otherwise the dwell count is zeroed and the debounce count set to 1. verdicts.final_comment: Idle shutdown state machine (e2m 10CD; state ISST 0 RESET / 1 COUNT / 2 WARNING / 3 DELAY / 4 OVERRIDE / 5 SHUTDOWN), one pass per 100 ms from cm550_runEvery20FramesTaskSetPhase11 while ISAGEN (idle_shutdown_enable, bit 1 of algorithm_enable_flags_3_cal) is set and ISTAEN (integrated_idle_management_enable, bit 4 of word 28) is clear. RESET reloads the timer ISTM from ISTMLM, clears ISWRRQ / ISOD / ISODFG, switches output 30 off and waits for ISRSFG = 0; COUNT counts ISTM down, returns to RESET on ISRSFG = 1 and enters WARNING when ISTM is at or below ISWRTMLM (or DELAY, 600 passes before OVERRIDE, when ISAATPEN and ISODFG are set); WARNING keeps counting, sets ISWRRQ and after ISWRTMLM passes enters SHUTDOWN, unless ISODEN with ISODFG gives OVERRIDE or ISRSWNFG gives RESET; OVERRIDE reloads the timer, sets ISOD and ISODRQ and waits for ISODRSFG; SHUTDOWN sets the engine shutdown command SHSS and switches output 30 on once, and returns to RESET when the engine is CRANKING. No code in the dumped ROM sets ISRSFG / ISRSWNFG / ISODRSFG / ISODFG while running (cm550_initializeIdleShutdown sets ISRSFG to 1 at start-up; RESET and the initializer clear ISODFG). CM848 S90140.06 has no idle shutdown machine.
